prompts.wall-left: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite for a cozy Korean public library game. Match these furniture references: clean warm light oak, sage plinth, confident medium dark brown outlines, matte hand-drawn flat colors with broad gentle shadows, restrained sage/cream/terracotta book colors. Front-facing orthographic view with slight top surface visible (about 20 degrees down), all horizontal shelf lines level, NO diagonal/isometric rotation, NO converging sides, NO perspective vanishing point. No people, no labels/letters/numbers, no wall or floor/background, genuine transparent outside silhouette, no cast floor shadow, no textures/grain/noisy tiny markings. Furniture feet/base and whole silhouette fully visible. Create ONE long rectangular CONTINUOUS WALL BOOKCASE, exactly THREE equal-width upright bays joined together, each bay contains THREE stacked rows of upright book spines. Full furniture silhouette aspect exactly 3.15 wide : 1 high. Consistent rectangular tall librarian shelves at human head height, very shallow visible top surface. A single unbroken oak top cornice across all three bays, two slim interior vertical uprights separating bays, NO gaps between three bays. A single continuous sage plinth at bottom; no tall legs. Top front fascia has one small PLAIN blank ivory horizontal label plate per bay, set into the wood (same size and height, wide enough for code and Korean category on one line; no text), with the book compartments beneath. Tightly but naturally filled with books of varied heights, several small horizontal stacks, leftbay predominantly mutedblue/cream, middlebay duskyrose/sage, rightbay mutedbrown/ochre. No plants or decorations on top. Keep cabinet end sides vertical and nearly invisible so two runs can be placed touching side by side.
